item.title: "Choosing Their Own Judge?" — The Intersection of Lee Jae-myung's Legal Risks and the Chief Justice Impeachment (“재판관 직접 고르나”… 이재명 사법 리스크와 대법원장 탄핵의 교차점)
item.description:
"Choosing Their Own Judge?" — The Intersection of Lee Jae-myung's Legal Risks and the Chief Justice Impeachment (“재판관 직접 고르나”… 이재명 사법 리스크와 대법원장 탄핵의 교차점)

When it became known that Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae had submitted Supreme Court justice nominees in writing, Kim Min-seok, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, immediately resorted to even the inflammatory remark "the worst Chief Justice since liberation" upon taking office, pressuring Chief Justice Jo to step down without delay. (조희대 대법원장이 대법관 후보자를 서면으로 제청한 사실이 알려지자, 김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 취임하자마자 “해방 이후 최악의 대법원장”이라는 원색적 표현까지 동원하며 조 대법원장의 즉각 사퇴를 압박하고 나섰다.)

However, looking closely at the full story behind this incident, it is difficult to shake the suspicion that this all-out offensive, cloaked in procedural controversy, is in fact closer to a premeditated political scheme long in the making. Based on SomeTrend big-data related-word and sentiment analysis, we examine the evidence. (그러나 이번 사태의 전말을 들여다보면 절차 논란을 명분으로 내세운 이 총공세가 실은 오래전부터 예정된 정치적 기획에 가깝다는 의구심을 지우기 어렵다. 썸트렌드 빅데이터 연관어·감성어 분석을 바탕으로 근거를 짚어본다.)

In SomeTrend's big-data related-word analysis (August 19–20, 2026), the keyword "Kim Min-seok" is tightly interwoven with terms such as "Korea," "Gyeonggi," "policy," "party members," "regions," "results," "a day," and "management." This shows that Representative Kim Min-seok is leveraging this issue at the very heart of a political drive to showcase the achievements of the new leadership early and rally party members and regional organizations. (썸트렌드(SomeTrend)의 빅데이터 연관어 분석(2026년 8월 19~20일)에서 ‘김민석’ 키워드는 ‘한국’, ‘경기’, ‘정책’, ‘당원’, ‘지역’, ‘결과’, ‘하루’, ‘운영’ 등과 함께 촘촘히 얽혀 있다. 이는 김민석 대표가 신임 지도부의 성과를 조기에 과시하고 당원·지역 조직을 결집시키려는 정치 행보 한복판에서 이번 사안을 활용하고 있음을 보여준다.)

Indeed, from the national convention period onward, he had already raised "impeachment of Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae" as a victory slogan. That being the case, the written nomination controversy is not a sudden discovery of "judicial abuse," but rather the awaited justification for pulling out an impeachment card that had been prepared well in advance. The People Power Party's point that "the very first words upon taking office being a call to impeach the Chief Justice reveal the true intent" is hardly an exaggeration. (실제로 그는 이미 전당대회 기간부터 “조희대 대법원장 탄핵”을 승리의 구호로 내걸었다. 그렇다면 이번 서면 제청 논란은 갑작스러운 ‘사법 농단’ 적발이 아니라, 진작부터 준비해 둔 탄핵 카드를 꺼내 들 명분을 기다리고 있던 셈이다. 국민의힘이 “취임 일성부터 대법원장 탄핵을 내건 것 자체가 목적이 무엇인지 보여준다”고 지적하는 대목은 과장이라 보기 어렵다.)

Associated words for "written nomination" also include "diversity," "consensus," "opportunity," "Park Soon-young," "National Assembly confirmation hearing," "questioning," and "vote." While it is true that the Supreme Court Justice Recommendation Committee recommended four candidates — Kim Min-ki, Park Soon-young, Yoon Sung-sik, and Son Bong-ki — in January, and that the presidential office and the Supreme Court had been coordinating the selection for over six months without reaching a conclusion, placing all the blame solely on the Supreme Court is not fair. (‘서면 제청’ 연관어에는 ‘다양성’ ‘합의’ ‘기회’ ‘박순영’ ‘국회 인사 청문회’ ‘질의’ ‘표결’이 함께 걸려 있다. 대법관후보추천위원회가 지난 1월 김민기·박순영·윤성식·손봉기 네 명을 추천한 뒤 청와대와 대법원이 인선을 조율해 온 지 반년이 넘도록 결론을 내지 못한 것은 사실이지만, 그 책임을 오로지 대법원에만 돌리는 것은 온당치 않다.)

Judge Kim Min-ki, reportedly favored by the presidential office, has a potential conflict of interest because her husband is Constitutional Court Justice Oh Young-jun. Nevertheless, the presidential office actively pushed for Judge Kim, citing the symbolism of a progressive-leaning female judge. Chief Justice Jo initially conceded his preferred candidate and sought compromise on Judge Park Soon-young, also a progressive female judge. However, for reasons unknown, the presidential office insisted solely on Judge Kim, and when coordination became difficult, Chief Justice Jo reportedly submitted Senior Judge Son Bong-ki — neither Kim nor Park — as an "unavoidable choice to end the vacancy crisis that had dragged on for over five months." (청와대가 원한 것으로 알려진 김민기 판사는 남편이 오영준 헌법재판관이라 이해충돌 소지가 있다. 그럼에도 청와대는 진보 성향·여성 법관이라는 상징성을 내세워 김 판사를 적극 천거했다. 조 대법원장은 당초 선호 후보를 양보하고 같은 진보·여성인 박순영 판사로 타협을 보려 했다. 그러나 무슨 이유에서인지 청와대에서 김 판사만을 고집하면서, 의견 조율이 어렵자 조 대법원장은 ‘5개월 넘게 이어진 공백 사태를 끝내려는 불가피한 선택’ 차원에서 김도 박도 아닌 손봉기 부장판사를 제청했다는 해석이다.)

Despite this, the Democratic Party immediately defined the matter as "judicial abuse" and went so far as to mention a resolution by the judges' assembly and impeachment of the Chief Justice. Floor leader Han Byeong-do claimed it violated the president's appointment authority, but under the Constitution, the right to nominate Supreme Court justices belongs exclusively to the Chief Justice, and as the People Power Party counters, there is considerable criticism that it was the presidential office attempting to intervene in the selection under the pretext of prior consultation that started the problem. (그럼에도 민주당은 이 사안을 곧바로 ‘사법 농단’으로 규정하고 법관회의 결의와 대법원장 탄핵까지 거론했다. 한병도 원내대표는 대통령 임명권 침해라고 주장했지만, 헌법상 대법관 제청권은 대법원장 고유 권한이며 국민의힘이 반박하듯 오히려 청와대가 사전 협의라는 관행을 빌미로 인선에 개입하려 한 것이 문제의 발단이라는 지적도 만만치 않다.)

Yet, rather than sorting out procedural disputes, the Democratic Party immediately hung "step down" banners nationwide and unleashed ad hominem attacks against the Chief Justice as an individual. Such an approach is far removed from the cause of protecting judicial independence, and instead can only be seen as an attempt to bend the judiciary through political pressure. (그런데도 민주당은 절차적 시비를 가리기보다 곧장 “물러나라”는 현수막을 전국에 내걸고 대법원장 개인을 향한 인신공격성 발언을 쏟아냈다. 이런 방식은 사법부 독립을 지키자는 명분과는 거리가 멀고, 오히려 사법부를 정치적 압박으로 굴복시키려는 시도로 비칠 수밖에 없다.)

SomeTrend's sentiment-related-word analysis reveals the outcome of this public opinion campaign in full. Sentiment words surrounding "Jo Hee-dae" are dominated by "conflict," "criticism," "criticize," "controversy," "warn," "take issue with," "defective," "destruction," "push back," "worst," "unilateral," and "disregard." This is close to a direct reflection of the Democratic Party's aggressive rhetoric onto the public opinion landscape. That is, public sentiment is being shaped by political slogans rather than rigorous assessment of procedural illegality. (썸트렌드 감성 연관어 분석은 이런 여론전의 결과를 고스란히 드러낸다. ‘조희대’를 둘러싼 감성어는 ‘갈등’, ‘비판’, ‘비판하다’, ‘논란’, ‘경고하다’, ‘문제 삼다’, ‘불량’, ‘파괴’, ‘반발하다’, ‘최악’, ‘일방적’, ‘무시하다’로 뒤덮여 있다. 이는 민주당의 공세적 언어가 여론 지형에 그대로 투영된 결과에 가깝다. 실제 절차 위법성에 대한 엄밀한 판단보다 정치적 구호에 의해 형성되고 있다는 점이다.)

The more fundamental problem lies in the background of this all-out offensive. President Lee Jae-myung's Public Official Election Act case was already remanded by the Supreme Court with a finding of guilt, and if the retrial resumes, the final decision will return to the Supreme Court once more. The presidential term is five years; the Supreme Court justice term is six years. (더 근본적인 문제는 이번 총공세의 배경에 있다. 이재명 대통령의 공직선거법 사건은 대법원이 이미 유죄 취지로 파기환송한 사안으로, 재판이 재개되면 최종 결론은 다시 대법원으로 돌아온다. 대통령 임기는 5년, 대법관 임기는 6년이다.)

In this structure, the ruling camp's anxiety to fill Supreme Court seats with progressive figures, and resorting to impeaching the Chief Justice when things do not go their way, cannot escape the criticism of "a defendant trying to pick his own judges." As Reform Party lawmaker Lee Jun-seok pointed out, contrary to the stated cause of protecting judicial independence, this can readily be read as an attempt to politically seize control of the judiciary to complete the president's "erasing of the trial." (이런 구조에서 여권이 진보 성향 인사로 대법관 자리를 채우려 안달하고 뜻대로 되지 않자 대법원장 탄핵까지 꺼내 드는 모습은 “피고인이 자신의 재판관을 고르려 한다”는 비판에서 자유로울 수 없다. 이준석 개혁신당 의원의 지적처럼, 이는 사법부 독립을 지키자는 명분과 달리 사법부를 정치적으로 장악해 대통령 ‘재판 지우기’를 완성하려는 시도로 읽힐 소지가 다분하다.)

The fact that, in the big-data related-word map, a keyword cluster of "Democratic Party of Korea," "Democratic Party," "Lee Jae-myung," and "president" sits precisely between "Kim Min-seok" and "written nomination" supports this interpretation. It is clear in the public opinion landscape that Kim Min-seok's individual remarks are simultaneously the party's position and directly tied to President Lee Jae-myung's legal risks. (빅데이터 연관어 지도에서 ‘김민석’과 ‘서면 제청’ 사이에 ‘더불어민주당’, ‘민주당’, ‘이재명’, ‘대통령’이라는 키워드 군집이 정확히 자리한다는 사실은 이 구도를 뒷받침한다. 김민석 개인의 발언이 곧 당의 입장이자 이재명 대통령의 사법 리스크와 직결돼 있다는 것이 여론 지형에서도 뚜렷하다.)

Indeed, sentiment words surrounding President Lee Jae-myung also capture a considerable number of negative terms such as "conflict," "criticism," "controversy," "concern," "backlash," "crime," "discontent," and "worst." Even if positive words like "expectation," "trust," and "success" are mixed in, the fact that negative sentiment related to his trial is so thickly formed means public doubt over the president's legal risks is by no means negligible. (실제로 이재명 대통령을 둘러싼 감성어에도 ‘갈등’, ‘비판’, ‘논란’, ‘우려’, ‘반발’, ‘범죄’, ‘불만’, ‘최악’이라는 부정 언어가 상당수 포착된다. ‘기대’, ‘신뢰’, ‘성공’ 같은 긍정어가 일부 섞여 있다 해도, 재판 관련 부정 감성이 이렇게 두텁게 형성돼 있다는 것은 대통령의 사법 리스크에 대한 여론의 의구심이 결코 가볍지 않다는 의미다.)

To soberly summarize this incident: Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae's "written nomination" did break with convention, but the response of Representative Kim Min-seok and the Democratic Party — pulling out an impeachment card prepared since taking office — has lost its balance. Going beyond pointing out procedural flaws to outright crude attacks on the Chief Justice, nationwide banner postings, and direct pressure to resign is hard to free from the criticism of judicial taming. It is also unfair to place sole responsibility for the over-five-month Supreme Court vacancy on the Supreme Court, as the presidential office itself bears no small responsibility for the failed coordination by pushing a nominee with conflict-of-interest concerns. (이번 사태를 냉정히 정리하면, 조희대 대법원장의 ‘서면 제청’이 관례를 깬 것은 사실이지만 이를 빌미로 취임 직후부터 준비된 탄핵 카드를 꺼내 든 김민석 대표와 민주당의 대응은 균형을 잃었다. 절차적 흠결을 지적하는 데 그치지 않고 대법원장을 향한 원색적 비난과 전국 현수막 게시, 사퇴 압박으로 직행한 것은 사법부 길들이기라는 비판에서 자유롭기 어렵다. 대법관 공백이 5개월 넘게 이어지는 근본 책임을 대법원에만 묻는 것도 공정하지 않다. 청와대 스스로 이해충돌 소지가 있는 인선으로 조율에 실패한 책임 역시 가볍지 않기 때문이다.)

The negative language of public opinion shown by big data is close to a direct transfer of the Democratic Party's hardline political rhetoric onto the public, and beneath it lies a thick cloud of suspicion that a plan to restructure the judiciary with the president's trial in mind is at work. The new ruling party leader's choice to lead with a hardline stance targeting the judiciary from the very start of his term can only be seen as prioritizing the consolidation of political support over stable governance. With the Supreme Court vacancy resolution and the National Assembly confirmation process still ahead, if the Democratic Party continues its baseless all-out offensive, the political burden will likely ultimately fall back on the ruling camp itself. (빅데이터가 보여주는 여론의 부정적 언어는 민주당의 강경한 정치 언어가 여론에 그대로 전이된 결과에 가깝고, 그 이면에는 대통령의 재판을 염두에 둔 사법부 재편 구상이 자리하고 있다는 의혹이 짙게 깔려 있다. 신임 여당 대표가 취임 초부터 사법부를 겨냥한 강경 노선을 앞세우는 모습은, 국정 운영의 안정보다 정치적 지지 기반 결집을 우선시한 선택으로 비칠 수밖에 없다. 대법관 공백 해소와 국회 인사 청문 절차가 남아 있는 지금 민주당이 명분 없는 총공세를 계속한다면 그 정치적 부담은 결국 여권 스스로에게 되돌아올 가능성이 크다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Ukraine asks South Korea specifically for latest Patriot missiles… government reluctant ([단독] 우크라, 한국에 ‘최신형 패트리엇’ 콕 집어 지원 요구… 정부는 난색)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Ukraine asks South Korea specifically for latest Patriot missiles… government reluctant ([단독] 우크라, 한국에 ‘최신형 패트리엇’ 콕 집어 지원 요구… 정부는 난색)

Ukraine, suffering from a shortage of air defense weapons in its war with Russia, reportedly asked South Korea through diplomatic and security channels to provide its latest Patriot interceptor missiles, it was learned on the 23rd. The South Korean side is said to have expressed reluctance, citing the need to prepare for contingencies on the Korean Peninsula, but some observers point out that consideration should be given to the possibility that this issue could affect the transfer of North Korean soldiers held as POWs by Ukraine to South Korea. (러시아와의 전쟁에서 방공 무기 부족을 겪고 있는 우크라이나가 외교안보 채널을 통해 한국에 최신형 패트리엇 요격 미사일 지원을 요청한 것으로 23일 알려졌다. 우리 측은 한반도 유사시 대비 등을 이유로 난색을 표한 것으로 전해졌지만, 일각에서는 이 문제가 우크라이나가 억류 중인 북한군 포로의 한국행에 영향을 줄 가능성 등을 고려해야 한다는 지적도 나온다.)

According to a compilation of this newspaper's reporting, Oleksandr Kamyshin, a strategic adviser and close aide to President Volodymyr Zelensky, visited South Korea in early last month and met with officials from the Ministry of National Defense and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration. At the meeting, Adviser Kamyshin reportedly mentioned a request for the supply of the 'PAC-3', the latest model among the U.S.-made Patriot interceptor missiles held by South Korea. The South Korean military possesses the improved version (PAC-3 MSE), which has a maximum altitude of 40 km, and it is assessed to have the capability to intercept missiles such as Russia's Iskander-M, which performs evasive maneuvers. Earlier, at the end of June, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, who visited South Korea, also reportedly explicitly requested "air defense weapon support" during his meeting with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul. (본지 취재를 종합하면, 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 대통령의 측근인 올렉산드르 카미신 전략담당 고문이 지난달 초 한국을 방문해 국방부와 방위사업청 관계자들을 면담했다. 카미신 고문은 이 자리에서 한국이 보유한 미국산 요격 미사일인 패트리엇 가운데 최신 기종인 ‘PAC-3’를 지원해 달라고 언급했다고 한다. 한국군은 최대 고도 40㎞인 개량형(PAC-3 MSE)을 보유하고 있으며, 이는 변칙 기동을 하는 러시아 이스칸데르-M 미사일 등을 요격할 수 있는 성능을 갖춘 것으로 평가된다. 앞서 지난 6월 말 방한한 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외무장관도 조현 외교부 장관과 면담에서 “방공 무기를 지원해달라”는 요구를 명시적으로 한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The South Korean government is known to have expressed reluctance, citing reasons such as the difficulty of providing cutting-edge air defense weapons while needing to prepare for North Korean missile provocations. The possibility of strong backlash from Russia, which is sensitive to weapons support for Ukraine, was also reportedly taken into account. (우리 정부는 북한 미사일 도발에 대비해야 하는 상황에서, 최신예 방공 무기를 제공하긴 어렵다는 등의 이유로 난색을 표한 것으로 알려졌다. 우크라이나 무기 지원에 예민한 러시아가 강하게 반발할 가능성도 고려된 것으로 알려졌다.)

However, Ukraine is escalating the level of its requests, with President Zelensky saying on the 8th, "We earnestly hope for South Korea's support for air defense systems." The government is known to have internally reviewed alternatives such as providing the domestically produced surface-to-air missile system Cheongung-II instead of Patriots. However, since export contracts have already been signed with Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the prevailing view is that securing additional units under the current production schedule would not be easy. (그러나 젤렌스키 대통령이 지난 8일 “방공 시스템에 대한 한국의 지원을 간절히 바라고 있다”고 말하는 등 우크라이나도 요청 수위를 높여가고 있다. 정부는 패트리엇 대신 국산 지대공 미사일인 천궁-Ⅱ를 지원하는 방법 등도 내부적으로 검토한 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 이미 사우디아라비아·아랍에미리트(UAE) 등과 수출 계약을 맺은 상태라, 생산 일정상 별도의 물량 확보가 쉽지 않다는 시각이 우세한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Shim Sang-min, senior research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, said, "It is worth considering providing air defense weapons that Ukraine desperately needs, as long as it does not undermine our defense posture," adding, "It would also have a positive impact on the issue of repatriating North Korean POWs." (심상민 아산정책연구원 선임연구위원은 “우리 방위 태세에 지장이 없는 선에서 우크라이나에 절실한 방공 무기를 지원하는 것도 검토할 필요가 있다”며 “북한군 포로 송환 문제에도 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Marks 'Six Straight Weeks of Decline' at 40.2%… Hits New Low (李대통령 지지율 ‘6주 연속 하락’ 40.2%… 최저치 경신)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Marks 'Six Straight Weeks of Decline' at 40.2%… Hits New Low (李대통령 지지율 ‘6주 연속 하락’ 40.2%… 최저치 경신)

A poll released on the 24th showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for his state affairs has fallen for six consecutive weeks, once again breaking its all-time low. (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 지지율이 6주 연속 하락하며 또다시 최저치를 경신했다는 여론조사 결과가 24일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Realmeter from the 18th to the 21st across 2,026 eligible voters aged 18 and older nationwide, commissioned by the Energy Economics Newspaper, the positive assessment of the President's performance dropped by 2.8 percentage points (p) from the previous week to 40.2%. The negative assessment rose by 2.8%p to 56.9%. The gap between positive and negative ratings stood at 16.7%p, outside the margin of error, while 3.0% responded "don't know." The President's approval rating has been on a steady decline since recording 48.9% in the survey conducted in the second week of July. <<> Realmeter interpreted, "Amid growing distrust in housing policies due to the controversy over housing supply in Yongsan Park, combined with the conflict between the ruling and opposition parties over Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's written recommendation and the push for constitutional amendment, as well as security concerns arising from the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, the exodus of conservative supporters and those aged 70 and older appears to have expanded." <<> In the party approval rating survey, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 41.9%, down 6.0%p from the previous survey, while the People Power Party rose 4.5%p to 37.6%. The Rebuilding Korea Party recorded 3.9%, the Progressive Party 2.3%, and the Reform Party 2.0%. Other parties accounted for 2.5%, and independents totaled 9.7%. <<> Realmeter attributed the decline in the Democratic Party's approval rating to the dissipation of the convention effect following the conclusion of its party leadership convention, the controversy over housing supply in Yongsan Park, and internal strife stemming from Kim Min-seok's leadership's selection of appointed Supreme Council members. It explained that the People Power Party capitalized on the ruling camp's housing policy controversy and security anxieties over the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises to rally conservative supporters and absorb defectors from the Democratic Party. (에너지경제신문 의뢰로 리얼미터가 지난 18일부터 21일까지 전국 18세 이상 유권자 2026명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, 이 대통령의 국정 수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 전주 대비 2.8%포인트(p) 하락한 40.2%로 집계됐다. 부정 평가는 56.9%로 지난주보다 2.8%p 상승했다. 긍정과 부정 평가의 격차는 16.7%p로 오차 범위 밖이었으며, ‘잘 모름’은 3.0%였다. 이 대통령의 지지율은 7월 둘째 주 조사에서 48.9%를 기록한 이후 줄곧 하락했다.)

item.title: If You've Changed Your Name or Resident Registration Number, a Single Visit to One Financial Institution Is Enough for Batch Updates (이름이나 주민번호 바꿨다면, 금융 기관 1곳만 방문해도 일괄 갱신)
item.description:
If You've Changed Your Name or Resident Registration Number, a Single Visit to One Financial Institution Is Enough for Batch Updates (이름이나 주민번호 바꿨다면, 금융 기관 1곳만 방문해도 일괄 갱신)

The government has decided to overhaul the relevant systems so that citizens who have changed their name or resident registration number can automatically update their personal information registered with all financial institutions by visiting just one institution. (국민이 이름이나 주민등록번호를 바꾼 경우, 금융기관 1곳만 방문해도 모든 금융기관에 등록된 개인 정보를 자동으로 바꿀 수 있도록 정부가 관련 시스템을 개편하기로 했다.)

According to the Office for Government Policy Coordination on the 24th, as of 2024, approximately 84,290 name changes and 1,225 resident registration number changes are made by citizens each year. (24일 국무조정실에 따르면, 2024년 기준으로 국민의 개명은 연간 8만4290건, 주민등록번호 변경은 연간 1225건씩 이뤄지고 있다.)

Currently, however, a person who has changed their name or resident registration number must visit each financial institution individually, submit supporting documents, and have the information corrected to update the personal details registered with those institutions. (그런데 개명이나 주민등록번호 변경을 한 사람이 금융기관에 등록된 개인 정보를 고치려면, 현재는 각 금융기관에 일일이 방문해 증빙 서류를 내고 고쳐야 한다.)

Following a proposal by Park Yong-jin, Vice Chair of the Regulatory Reform Committee and Head of the Livelihood Affairs Subcommittee, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Financial Services Commission, and the Financial Supervisory Service have decided to address this issue. (규제합리화위원회 박용진 부위원장 겸 민생분과위원장의 제안으로, 행정안전부와 금융위원회, 금융감독원이 이런 문제점을 개선하기로 했다.)

Currently, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety only notifies the Korea Credit Information Services of whether a specific individual's resident registration number has been changed, but going forward, it will provide information on individuals whose names, dates of birth, gender, or resident registration numbers have changed, including details before and after the change. (행안부는 현재는 한국신용정보원에 특정인의 주민등록번호가 변경됐는지 여부만을 알려주고 있으나, 앞으로는 이름이나 생년월일, 성별, 주민등록번호가 변경된 사람에 대해, 변경 전후 정보를 알려주기로 했다.)

The Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service have decided to build an "information linkage system" that shares the information received by the Korea Credit Information Services collectively with multiple financial companies, automatically updating the registered personal information. (금융위와 금감원은 한국신용정보원에 들어온 정보를 여러 금융회사에 일괄 공유해 등록된 개인정보를 자동으로 변경시키는 ‘정보 연계 시스템’을 구축하기로 했다.)

Accordingly, if a person whose personal information has changed visits one of the financial institutions they normally deal with, notifies them of the change, and consents to the provision and use of their personal information, the Korea Credit Information Services will verify the changed information and provide it collectively to each financial institution the following day. Each financial institution will then update its customer records based on the information received. (이에 따라, 개인 정보가 바뀐 사람이 평소 거래하는 금융기관 가운데 한 곳을 방문해 변경 사실을 알리고 개인 정보 제공·활용에 동의하면, 한국신용정보원은 변경 정보를 검증한 뒤 다음날 각 금융 기관에 해당 정보를 일괄 제공하며, 각 금융 기관은 제공받은 정보를 바탕으로 자사의 고객 정보를 갱신하게 된다.)

However, identity verification means such as certificates or OTPs must be reissued individually by the person whose personal information has changed. (다만 인증서나 OTP 등 본인 확인 수단은 개인정보 변경자가 각각 직접 재발급받아야 한다.)

The government stated, "Through these improvement measures, we expect that the inconvenience of financial transactions for ordinary citizens after name changes or resident registration number changes will be significantly reduced," and added, "We will continue to carefully examine unnecessary procedures and burdens in daily life and actively identify and implement regulatory rationalization measures that citizens can feel in practice." (정부는 “이번 개선 조치를 통해 개명 및 주민등록번호 변경 후 일반 국민의 금융 거래 번거로움이 대폭 줄어들 것으로 기대된다”며 “앞으로도 일상생활 속 불필요한 절차와 부담을 세심하게 살피고, 국민이 체감할 수 있는 규제 합리화 방안을 적극 발굴해 개선해 나갈 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: DP's Park Seong-jun: "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act Must Be Handled in September" (與 박성준 “조작 기소 특검법 9월 처리해야”)
item.description:
DP's Park Seong-jun: "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act Must Be Handled in September" (與 박성준 “조작 기소 특검법 9월 처리해야”)

Park Seong-jun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 24th that the "fabricated indictment special counsel act" related to President Lee Jae-myung's case should be handled at the regular parliamentary session in September. Ahead of the June 3 local elections, the DP had attempted to pass a special counsel bill granting the special counsel authority to withdraw prosecutions, but put it on hold as criticism mounted. (박성준 더불어민주당 수석대변인은 24일 이재명 대통령 사건과 관련한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’을 오는 9월 정기국회에서 처리해야 한다는 입장을 밝혔다. 민주당은 지난 6·3 지방선거 직전 특검에 공소 취소 권한을 부여한 특검 법안을 통과시키려다가 비판이 커지자 일단 보류한 상태다.)

In a radio interview that day, Senior Spokesperson Park said, "The members of the special committee (the parliamentary special committee for investigating the truth behind suspicions of fabricated indictments by politically motivated prosecutors) — including Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo, Judiciary Committee senior secretary Kim Seung-won, and lawmaker Lee Geon-tae — asked when it would be best to pass the bill," adding, "Since the prosecution's fabricated indictments have been fully exposed, I conveyed my personal position that it should be handled as soon as the regular session begins in September." (박 수석대변인은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 “특위(정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사특위)에서 함께 활동했던 서영교 법사위원장과 김승원 법사위 간사, 이건태 의원 등이 (특검법을) 언제 통과시키면 좋겠냐고 물었다”며 “검찰의 조작 기소가 낱낱이 드러난 만큼 9월 정기국회가 시작되면서 바로 처리하는 것이 맞다는 개인적인 입장을 전달했다”고 했다.)

The DP introduced the fabricated indictment special counsel act in April, stating it would "thoroughly investigate the suspicions of fabricated investigations and indictments raised under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration." However, many of the investigation targets are cases directly or indirectly related to President Lee. The DP had initially included in the bill a provision granting the special counsel the authority to withdraw prosecutions in eight cases involving President Lee, including the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool cases. (민주당은 지난 4월 “윤석열 정권하에서 제기된 조작 수사와 기소 의혹을 철저히 규명하겠다”며 조작 기소 특검법을 발의했다. 다만 수사 대상은 이 대통령과 직간접적으로 연관된 사건들이 많다. 민주당은 당초 법안에 특검이 이 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 등 8개 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 권한을 부여했었다.)

Regarding the provision granting the special counsel the authority to directly withdraw illegally prosecuted cases, Senior Spokesperson Park said, "This is a matter that will be sufficiently discussed within the Legislation and Judiciary Committee," and added, "The bill was proposed by the fabricated indictment special committee, and the final decision will be made after review by the Judiciary Committee's subcommittee for bill review and the full committee." (박 수석대변인은 특검에 불법 기소 사건을 직접 철회할 수 있는 ‘공소취소권’을 부여하는 조항에 대해 “법사위 안에서 충분한 논의가 이뤄질 사안”이라며 “조작기소특위에서 법안을 발의했고 법사위 법안심사소위와 전체회의 검토를 거쳐 최종 결정될 것”이라고 했다.)

On the prosecution's anticipated appeal following former DP lawmaker Noh Woong-rae's acquittal in the second trial, he said, "As senior spokesperson, I am cautious about issuing an official party position," but added, "I served with former lawmaker Noh in parliamentary activities and have witnessed his pain." He continued, "The greatest strength of a politician is running in elections, but that was completely blocked, and he went through many hardships during the trial process. Since he was acquitted in both the first and second trials, the prosecution should also make a wise decision." (그는 노웅래 전 민주당 의원의 2심 무죄 판결에 따른 검찰의 상고 전망에 대해선 “수석대변인으로서 당의 공식 입장을 내놓는 것은 조심스럽다”면서도 “노 전 의원과 의정 활동을 함께하며 그 아픔을 지켜봐 왔다”고 했다. 이어 “정치인의 가장 큰 힘은 선거 출마인데 그것이 원천 봉쇄됐고 재판 과정에서 많은 어려움을 겪었다”며 “1심과 2심에서 모두 무죄가 나온 만큼 검찰도 현명한 판단을 해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the view that President Lee Jae-myung's apology — made after former lawmaker Noh's acquittal in the appellate trial for having excluded him from candidacy (cut-off) during the general election as party leader at the time — was a preemptive move to build momentum for withdrawing prosecutions in his own case, Park said, "As the saying goes, 'what you see depends on what you look through,'" adding, "Looking at the court's first and second trial rulings in former lawmaker Noh's case, don't the rulings themselves show how the investigation was conducted and that it involved illegal evidence and unlawful investigation?" (노 전 의원의 항소심 무죄 판결 직후 이재명 대통령이 당시 당대표로서 총선 공천을 배제(컷오프)했던 것에 대해 사과한 것을 놓고 대통령 본인 사건의 공소 취소를 위한 사전 빌드업이라는 시각이 나오는 데 대해 “뭐 눈에는 뭐로 보인다고 한다”며 “(노 전 의원 사건에서) 법원의 1심·2심 판결 내용을 보면 어떻게 수사가 이뤄졌는지, 위법증거·불법 수사였다는 점이 판결로 나온 것 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park said, "At the time (of the candidacy exclusion), amid the media landscape and the exercise of power by the ruling camp, the public opinion battle and the election itself were framed in a very difficult way," and added, "As party leader at the time, who had to lead the party to victory in the general election, Lee Jae-myung removed former lawmaker Noh with a heavy heart, like 'cutting one's own flesh to save the body.'" He added, "This apology was a conveyance of that heartache." (박 수석대변인은 “(공천배제 당시) 언론 지형과 집권 세력의 권한 행사 속에서 여론전과 선거 자체가 매우 어려운 프레임이었다”며 “총선 승리를 이끌어야 했던 당시 이재명 당대표가 ‘읍참마속’의 심정으로 노 전 의원을 정리했던 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “이번 사과는 그 마음의 아픔을 전달한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Audit Chief Gathers Vice Ministers: "No Punishment for Hardworking Officials... Encourage 'Proactive Administration'" (정부 차관들 불러모은 감사원장 “열심히 일한 공무원 처벌 않겠다… ‘적극 행정’ 해달라”)
item.description:
Audit Board Chairman Kim Ho-cheol met with vice ministers from major ministries for breakfast on the 24th, stating, "I will ensure that officials who work hard are not punished." (김호철 감사원장이 24일 주요 부처 차관들을 불러 조찬을 함께하며 “열심히 일한 공무원이 처벌받는 일이 없게 하겠다”고 했다.)

According to the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI), Chairman Kim held a breakfast meeting with nine vice-ministerial officials from nine ministries at a restaurant in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, that morning. Attendees included the Second Vice Minister of Finance and Economy, the First Vice Minister of Science and ICT, the First Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vice Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, the First Vice Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Vice Minister of Employment and Labor, the Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the First Vice Minister of SMEs and Startups, and the Vice Chairman of the Financial Services Commission. The BAI's Secretary General and the head of the Planning and Coordination Office accompanied the Chairman. <<> Chairman Kim first expressed gratitude to the vice ministers, saying, "You are coordinating countless interests, overcoming difficulties on the ground, and directing the practical implementation of policies for the people." <<> He then introduced his initiatives, saying, "Since taking office late last year, I have set operating principles such as 'a paradigm shift in auditing to enhance public welfare' under the goal of 'an audit that the people trust, a BAI that stands upright,' and have been redesigning the overall operations of the Board." <<> Chairman Kim emphasized, "I will ensure that officials who work hard are not punished." He added, "We are making significant efforts to expand proactive administration throughout the public service, including abolishing audits on the rightness or wrongness of policy decisions, expanding the scope of immunity for proactive actions, and increasing the departments responsible for pre-consultation." <<> Chairman Kim said, "However, it is useless if public officials do not feel the change firsthand," and urged the vice ministers, "Please effectively convey the BAI's efforts to establish proactive administration and its transformed image so that frontline officials can experience it." <<> Chairman Kim also stressed, "The BAI and each ministry share the common goal of enabling the people to live safely and prosperously," adding, "Efforts to actively communicate and understand each other are essential." <<> It is unusual for the Chairman of the BAI to summon deputy heads of major audited agencies for a meeting. A BAI official explained, "The gathering was arranged to showcase the Board's changed approach and encourage proactive administration." The BAI stated, "We plan to actively pursue communication meetings to hear voices from the field in the future." item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Establishing the Grand Unity Promotion Task Force Directly Under the Party Leader... Beginning All-Directional Solidarity" (김민석 “당대표 직속 TF 대통합추진단 설치…전방위 연대 시작”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Establishing the Grand Unity Promotion Task Force Directly Under the Party Leader... Beginning All-Directional Solidarity" (김민석 “당대표 직속 TF 대통합추진단 설치…전방위 연대 시작”)

Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok announced on the 24th that he has established a Grand Unity Promotion Task Force directly under the party leader and appointed lawmaker Park Beom-gye as its head. (더불어민주당 김민석 대표는 24일 당대표 직속 대통합 추진단을 설치하고 박범계 의원을 단장으로 선임했다고 밝혔다.)

At the Supreme Council meeting that day, Kim said, "I will build an unbroken bridge of dialogue with the main opposition, the People Power Party, and a bridge of solidarity toward the future with reformist and progressive parties." (김 대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 “제1야당인 국민의힘과는 끊어지지 않는 대화의 다리를, 개혁진보 정당들과는 미래를 향한 연대의 다리를 놓겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "I have established the Grand Unity Promotion Task Force as a TF directly under the party leader, appointing lawmaker Park Beom-gye as its head, with lawmaker Jin Seong-jun as chairman of the Progressive Solidarity Subcommittee, lawmaker Lee Hae-sik as chairman of the Rebuilding Korea Party Solidarity Subcommittee, and lawmakers Hwang Myeong-seon and Lee So-young as co-chairs of the Recruitment and Expansion Subcommittee." (그러면서 “당대표 직속 TF로 대통합 추진단을 설치하고, 박범계 의원을 단장으로, 산하에 진보연대분과 위원장 진성준 의원, 조국혁신당 연대분과 위원장 이해식 의원, 영입 확장분과 공동위원장 황명선 의원, 이소영 의원을 임명했다”고 했다.)

Kim also said, "We will begin large-scale, swift, all-directional solidarity, unity, and expansion." (김 대표는 “대대적이고 신속한 전방위 연대, 통합, 확장을 시작하겠다”고도 했다.)

He also launched a TF to address issues raised during the party convention process. Kim stated, "To improve problems such as voting without speeches and surveys without verification, I will soon establish a TF for convention evaluation and convention system reform centered on external figures." (전당대회 과정에서 제기된 문제를 해결하는 TF도 발족한다. 김 대표는 “연설 없는 투표, 검증 없는 조사 등의 문제점 개선을 위해 곧 외부 인사 중심으로 전대 평가 및 전대 제도 개선 TF를 설치하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Kim also said, "With Supreme Council member Park Seon-won as its head, we will produce results quickly." (김 대표는 “박선원 최고위원을 단장으로 해 신속히 성과를 만들어 내겠다”고도 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] People Power Party Supreme Council Delays Vote on Chang Dong-hyuk's Proposal for Direct Party Member Election of District Chapter Chiefs ([속보] 국힘 최고위, 張 추진 ‘당협위원장 당원 직선제’ 의결 보류)
item.description:
[Breaking News] People Power Party Supreme Council Delays Vote on Chang Dong-hyuk's Proposal for Direct Party Member Election of District Chapter Chiefs ([속보] 국힘 최고위, 張 추진 ‘당협위원장 당원 직선제’ 의결 보류)

The People Power Party (PPP) postponed a vote on the direct election of district chapter (party branch) chiefs by party members, a proposal pushed by leader Chang Dong-hyuk, at its Supreme Council meeting on the 24th. The move is seen as Chang's leadership team stepping back to regroup after lawmakers voiced backlash during back-to-back general meetings of lawmakers held last week. (국민의힘이 24일 최고위원회에서 장동혁 대표가 추진하는 당협위원장 당원직선제 의결을 보류했다. 지난주 연이틀 열린 의원총회에서 의원들 반발이 이어지자 장동혁 지도부가 숨고르기에 나섰다는 평가다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, that "the direct election of district chapter chiefs by party members was not placed on today's agenda, and it has been decided to discuss it at the next Supreme Council meeting." (박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 최고위 직후 기자들과 만나 “당협위원장 당원직선제는 오늘 안건으로 상정되지 않았고 다음 최고위에서 논의하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

As soon as the meeting went into closed session, Chang reportedly said, "Let's find a reasonable approach and have further discussions at the next Supreme Council." The Supreme Council meeting then concluded without any substantive debate. (이날 회의가 비공개로 전환되자마자 장 대표는 “합리적인 방안을 찾아 다음 최고위에서 여러 가지 논의를 더 해보자”고 발언한 것으로 전해졌다. 이후 별다른 논의 없이 최고위는 끝났다.)

Park said, "This was an idea that emerged from the process of establishing the party's direction and identity to reorganize itself into a party that can fight properly in the next general election." He added, "Nevertheless, given that some are distorting its sincerity, I believe there was a judgment that it was still too early to reach a conclusion today." (박 수석대변인은 “조직을 정비해서 다음 총선에서 제대로 싸울 수 있는 정당으로 변모하기 위한 당의 방향성과 정체성을 확립하는 과정에서 나온 아이디어였다”며 “그럼에도 불구하고 일부에서 그 진정성이 왜곡되고 있는 상황에서 오늘 결론을 내기에는 아직 이르다는 판단이 있었다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Chang has previously stressed a fight against the opposition, saying, "Only 20% of lawmakers are fighting now; we will build a party where 80% fight," and has signaled his intent to restructure the party around its members. However, senior and non-mainstream lawmakers have called it "an attempt to replace district chapter chiefs with pro-Chang figures ahead of the next general election." At the general meeting of lawmakers on the 21st, senior lawmakers from the Yeongnam region, including Kim Tae-ho, Yoon Han-hong, and Lee Man-hee, reportedly made a series of remarks opposing revisions to the method of selecting district chapter chiefs. (장 대표는 그간 “의원 중 20%만 싸우고 있는데, 80%가 싸우는 당을 만들겠다”며 대여 투쟁을 강조하고, 당원 중심으로 당을 재편하겠다는 뜻을 밝혀왔다. 하지만 중진과 비당권파 의원들은 “차기 총선을 앞두고 친장동혁 당협위원장으로 물갈이하려는 시도”라고 했다. 지난 21일 의원총회에서는 김태호, 윤한홍, 이만희 의원 등 영남권 중진 의원들을 중심으로 당협위원장 선출 방식 개정에 반대하는 취지의 발언이 잇따른 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: 85% of FSS Employees Say "Would Consider Leaving If Relocated to Regions" (금감원 직원 85%가 “지방 가면 이직 고려”)
item.description:
85% of FSS Employees Say "Would Consider Leaving If Relocated to Regions" (금감원 직원 85%가 “지방 가면 이직 고려”)

As the government is set to announce plans this week for relocating government ministries and public institutions to regional areas, it was found on the 23rd that the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS), which is known to be slated for relocation from Seoul to Sejong, has seen more than 100 employees resign each year. An internal FSS survey showed that 85.6% of respondents said they "would consider changing jobs if the relocation to a regional area proceeds." (정부가 이번주 정부 부처 및 공공기관 지방 이전 계획을 발표하는 가운데, 서울에서 세종으로 이전할 것으로 알려진 금융감독원에서 해마다 100명 이상의 직원이 퇴직하는 것으로 23일 나타났다. 금감원 내부 조사에선 “지방 이전 추진 시 이직을 고려하겠다”는 응답이 85.6%로 나타났다.)

According to data submitted by the FSS to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Park Seong-hoon, the number of retirees from the FSS over the five years from 2022 to July this year totaled 481. By year, there were 102 retirees in 2022, 103 in 2023, 110 in 2024, and 112 last year, showing a trend of annual increases. This year, 54 employees had already left the FSS as of last month. (국민의힘 박성훈 의원실이 금감원에서 제출받은 자료에 따르면 2022년부터 올해 7월까지 5년간 금감원 퇴직자 수는 481명이었다. 연도별로 2022년 102명, 2023년 103명, 2024년 110명, 지난해 112명으로 퇴직자는 해마다 늘어나는 추세다. 올해도 지난달까지 54명의 직원이 금감원을 떠났다.)

By age group, the departure of working-level staff in their 20s to 40s stood out. Among retirees over the past five years, 26 were in their 20s, 71 in their 30s, and 83 in their 40s, totaling 180 people, or 37.4% of all retirees. Of the 54 retirees this year, half—27 people—were in their 20s to 40s. (연령별로 보면 실무진인 20~40대의 이탈이 두드러졌다. 최근 5년간 퇴직자 가운데 20대가 26명, 30대가 71명, 40대가 83명으로 전체 퇴직자의 37.4%(180명)에 달한다. 올해 발생한 퇴직자 54명 중에서도 절반인 27명이 20~40대였다.)

From 2016 through last month, the most common destination for FSS retirees undergoing employment review by the Public Official Ethics Committee was Kim & Chang law firm, with a total of 25 cases. It was followed by major law firms including Law Firm Kwangjang (12 cases), Yulchon (10), Sejong (9), Pacific (8), and Hwawoo (6). (2016년부터 지난달까지 금감원 퇴직자가 공직자윤리위원회에서 가장 많이 취업 심사를 받은 곳은 김앤장 법률사무소로 도합 25건이었다. 법무법인 광장(12건), 율촌(10건), 세종(9건), 태평양(8건), 화우(6건) 등 대형 로펌이 그 뒤를 이었다.)

The FSS has been named as a candidate for relocation every time discussions on moving public institutions to regional areas have arisen. At the start of the Lee Jae-myung administration, it was also a target for regional relocation, but the plan was put on hold once due to internal opposition. In particular, many have pointed out that it would be inappropriate for a supervisory authority to move to a regional area while banks and other financial institutions remain in Seoul. (금감원은 공공기관 지방 이전 논의 때마다 대상으로 올랐다. 이재명 정부 출범 초에도 지방 이전 대상이었는데 내부 반발로 한차례 보류한 바 있다. 특히 은행 등 금융권은 서울에 두고 감독기관이 지방으로 내려가는 게 부적절하단 지적이 많았다.)

If the government announces its plan for relocating public institutions to regional areas on the 25th, concerns are rising that the exodus of FSS employees will accelerate. Indeed, in a recent survey conducted by the FSS labor union targeting 1,538 members, 85.6% of respondents said they "would consider changing jobs if relocated to a regional area." Among employees under the age of 40, the intention to leave due to regional relocation was even higher, at 92.5%. (정부가 오는 25일 공공기관 지방 이전 계획을 발표한다면, 금감원의 직원 이탈이 가속화할 것이란 말이 나온다. 실제 금감원 노동조합이 최근 구성원 1538명을 대상으로 실시한 설문조사 결과 응답자의 85.6%가 “지방 이전 시 이직을 고려한다”고 답했다. 지방 이전에 따른 이직 의향은 만 40세 미만 직원들에선 92.5%로 더 높게 나타났다.)

Lawmaker Park Seong-hoon stated, "The FSS is suffering from a dual hardship: externally, the revolving door of 'Geumpia' (FSS alumni) talent, and internally, the departure of working-level staff," adding, "The fact that half of this year's retirees are in their 20s to 40s is by no means a trivial issue for the FSS's organizational competitiveness and the expertise of financial supervision." (박성훈 의원은 “금감원은 밖으로는 인력들의 ‘금피아 회전문’, 안으로는 실무진 이탈이라는 이중고를 겪고 있다”며 “올해 퇴직자의 절반이 20~40대라는 것은 금감원의 조직 경쟁력과 금융감독 전문성 측면에서 결코 가볍게 볼 문제가 아니다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Calls Noh's Acquittal a "Fabricated Indictment" — Opposition Says "Build-Up to Dropping Lee's Charges Begins" (與, 노웅래 무죄에 “조작 기소”… 야권 “李 공소취소 빌드업”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Calls Noh's Acquittal a "Fabricated Indictment" — Opposition Says "Build-Up to Dropping Lee's Charges Begins" (與, 노웅래 무죄에 “조작 기소”… 야권 “李 공소취소 빌드업”)

Following the appeals court's acquittal of former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae on charges of bribery and illegal political funds on the 21st, following his acquittal in the first trial, the ruling bloc has launched a unified offensive against the prosecution. President Lee Jae-myung called it "a vicious act by political prosecutors and a case of abuse of state power," while Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok said it was "a case where the prosecution dragged an innocent man through the mud." The opposition said, "The build-up to dropping the charges against President Lee has begun." (뇌물 및 불법 정치자금 수수 혐의로 기소된 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원이 1심에 이어 지난 21일 항소심에서도 무죄를 선고받자 여권이 일제히 검찰에 대한 공세에 나섰다. 이재명 대통령은 “정치 검찰의 패악질이자 국가 권력의 악용 사례”라고 했고, 김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 “검찰이 생사람을 잡은 케이스”라고 했다. 야권은 “이 대통령 사건의 공소 취소 빌드업이 시작됐다”고 했다.)

The ruling bloc characterized the case against former lawmaker Noh as "a fabricated indictment and fabricated investigation created by political prosecutors abusing state power." In a briefing on the 23rd, Democratic Party senior spokesperson Park Sung-joon said, "The acquittal of former lawmaker Noh Woong-rae is a case where the true nature of the Yoon Suk-yeol political prosecution's illegal investigations has been fully exposed," adding, "This ruling will be recorded on the death certificate of the Yoon Suk-yeol political prosecution." (여권은 노 전 의원 사건을 “국가 권력을 악용해 만들어낸 정치 검찰의 조작 기소, 조작 수사”라고 규정했다. 박성준 민주당 수석대변인은 23일 브리핑에서 “노웅래 전 의원의 무죄 판결은 윤석열 정치검찰의 불법수사 실체가 낱낱이 드러난 사건”이라며 “이번 판결은 윤석열 정치검찰의 사망진단서에 기록될 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, President Lee also posted on X on the evening of the 21st regarding Noh's acquittal, saying, "He became the prey of relentless political prosecutors and was ultimately indicted, branded as a corrupt criminal." He also apologized for cutting off Noh, who was the incumbent lawmaker for Mapo-gu Gap in Seoul ahead of the 2024 general election, during his time as Democratic Party leader. President Lee said, "As the person leading the Democratic Party at the time, I had no choice but to swallow my tears and exclude former lawmaker Noh from the nomination," and "As party leader, for the sake of the overall election, I had no choice but to go along with the vicious acts of political prosecutors and make a painful sacrifice." He added, "How could anyone who is not the person involved possibly imagine how unjust it must have been for Senior Noh, who was indicted by political prosecutors and even stripped of his political life by the party?" He continued, "Senior, I am sorry. I respect you. I love you." On the same day, Kim Min-seok also wrote on Facebook, "At this point, wouldn't a prosecutor with a conscience need to take responsibility for what they started and make a public apology?" (앞서 이 대통령도 지난 21일 저녁 X에서 노 전 의원 무죄에 대해 “집요한 정치 검찰의 먹이가 되어 결국 부정부패 사범으로 몰려 기소됐다”고 했다. 민주당 대표 시절 2024년 총선을 앞두고 서울 마포갑 현역이었던 노 전 의원을 컷오프(공천 배제)한 것도 사과했다. 이 대통령은 “당시 민주당을 지휘하던 저는 눈물을 머금고 노 전 의원님을 공천 배제할 수밖에 없었다”며 “당 대표로서 전체 선거를 위해 정치 검찰의 패악질에 편승하여 읍참마속할 수밖에 없었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정치 검찰에 의해 기소되고 당에 의해 정치 생명까지 박탈당한 노 선배님께서 얼마나 억울했을지, 당사자가 아닌 한 어떻게 짐작이나 할 수 있겠나”라고 했다. 이어 “선배님 죄송합니다. 존경합니다. 사랑합니다”라고 했다. 김민석 대표도 같은 날 페이스북에 “이쯤 되면 결자해지, 석고대죄해야 양심 검찰 아닌가”라고 썼다.)

The Democratic Party in particular strongly criticized independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was the Minister of Justice at the time of Noh's indictment in 2023. Spokesperson Shin Hyun-young said in a written briefing, "It took a whopping three years and nine months to correct the fabricated indictment and fabricated investigation by the Han Dong-hoon political prosecution," and demanded, "Lawmaker Han, who turned an innocent person into a criminal, should apologize." Former Justice Party leader Cho Kook also criticized Han, calling him "a perpetrator of unconstitutional nonsense and still a prosecutorial absolutist." (민주당은 특히 노 전 의원 기소 당시인 2023년 법무장관이었던 한동훈 무소속 의원을 강하게 비판했다. 신현영 대변인은 서면 브리핑에서 “한동훈 정치 검찰의 조작 기소, 조작 수사를 바로잡는 데 무려 3년 9개월이나 걸렸다”며 “무고한 사람을 범죄자로 둔갑시킨 한 의원은 사과하라”고 했다. 조국혁신당 조국 전 대표도 한 의원을 비판하며 “반헌법적 궤변이자, 여전히 검찰주의자”라고 했다.)

In response, Han said the acquittal of former lawmaker Noh was not because he did not actually receive money, but because evidence such as recorded files was illegally obtained. He rebutted on Facebook, "In the courtroom for the Noh case, the recording of the conversation between the broker's wife and former lawmaker Noh, which was played, went beyond the level of 'the sound of rustling money envelopes' and contained explicit 'conversations after receiving money.'" He then struck back, saying, "If he's going to keep insisting he's innocent and did nothing wrong, let's all listen to that recording together in the National Assembly." Regarding President Lee's apology, Han also said, "It's an obvious ploy to build up to dropping the charges." (이에 대해 한 의원은 노 전 의원의 무죄 판결은 실제 금품을 받지 않은 게 아니라 녹음 파일 등 증거가 위법하게 수집된 것으로 인한 무죄라고 했다. 그는 페이스북을 통해 “노 전 의원 사건 법정에서도 재생된 브로커의 부인과 노 전 의원 간의 대화 녹음 파일에는 ‘돈 봉투 부스럭거리는 소리’ 차원을 넘어 ‘돈을 받은 뒤의 대화’가 적나라하게 담겨 있었다”고 반박했다. 이어 “억울하고 잘못이 없는 것처럼 계속 우길 거면 국회에서 그 녹음 파일 다 같이 한번 들어보자”고 반격했다. 한 의원은 이 대통령의 사과에 대해 “공소 취소 빌드업을 하려는 뻔한 속셈”이라고도 했다.)

The People Power Party strongly pushed back, saying, "President Lee, who is jumping on the bandwagon of Noh Woong-rae's acquittal to neutralize the prosecution, should stop his judicial shielding." In a commentary, senior spokesperson Park Sung-hoon said, "Is it normal state affairs for a president to ignore the essence of a ruling and demonize the prosecution as if waiting for this moment, using a specific politician's trial result as material for neutralizing the prosecution and judicial shielding?" He added, "We will never tolerate such low-grade judicial shielding politics that seeks to erase his own legal risks using the Noh Woong-rae case as a shield." (국민의힘은 “노웅래 무죄에 숟가락 얹어 검찰 무력화 나선 이 대통령은 사법 방탄을 멈추라”고 강력 반발했다. 박성훈 수석대변인은 논평에서 “대통령이 판결의 본질은 외면한 채 기다렸다는 듯 검찰을 악마화하고 특정 정치인의 재판 결과를 검찰 무력화와 사법 방탄의 재료로 삼는 것이 과연 정상적인 국정인가”라며 “노웅래 사건을 방패 삼아 자신의 사법 리스크까지 지우려는 저급한 사법 방탄 정치를 결코 좌시하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee plans to invite Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok's leadership team to the presidential residence on the 25th, followed by all Democratic Party lawmakers on the 28th, for luncheons. Attention is focused on whether discussions about dropping the charges will take place at these meetings. (한편 이 대통령은 오는 25일 민주당 김민석 지도부, 오는 28일 민주당 의원 전원을 차례로 청와대로 초청해 오찬을 가질 예정이다. 이 자리에서 공소 취소 관련 대화가 오갈지 주목된다.)

Initially, the Democratic Party had proposed a special counsel bill granting the authority to drop charges in fabricated indictment cases, right before the election in June, and sought to pass it through the National Assembly, but put it on hold after facing backlash. Since then, Leader Kim Min-seok has repeatedly mentioned the need to drop the charges against the president throughout the August 17 party convention, leading to expectations that the Democratic Party will soon push forward with the special counsel. President Lee also instructed during his press conference in April that the National Assembly take the lead on the special counsel. A key ruling bloc official said, "Now that the local elections are over and a pro-Lee, not pro-Chung, leadership has taken over the Democratic Party," adding, "The president and those around him have maintained that the prosecution's indictment is unjust, so what was done wrong must be corrected." (당초 민주당은 지난 6월 선거 직전 특검이 공소 취소 권한을 갖는 조작 기소 특검법안을 발의한 뒤 국회에서 통과시키려고 했다가 역풍이 불자 일단 보류한 상태다. 이후 김민석 대표가 이번 8·17 전당대회 내내 대통령 사건의 공소 취소 필요성을 여러 번 언급하면서 민주당이 조만간 특검 처리에 나설 것이란 전망이 나왔다. 이 대통령도 지난 4월 기자회견 때 특검과 관련해 국회 주도 처리를 주문한 바 있다. 여권 핵심 관계자는 “이제 지방선거도 끝났고 민주당에 친청이 아닌 친명 지도부가 들어섰다”며 “대통령과 대통령 주변은 검찰 기소에 대해 억울하다는 입장이기 때문에 잘못된 건 바로 잡아야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Clean Sweep" Pro-Chang 3040 Saturation... Yeongnam Lawmakers Caught Off Guard (“싹 정리” 친장계 3040 포화에… 뒤통수 맞은 영남 의원들)
item.description:
"Clean Sweep" Pro-Chang 3040 Saturation... Yeongnam Lawmakers Caught Off Guard (“싹 정리” 친장계 3040 포화에… 뒤통수 맞은 영남 의원들)

As People Power Party (PPP) leader Chang Dong-hyuk pushes for a direct member vote to select district party chairmen, pro-Chang figures outside the National Assembly are increasingly calling for a "shakeup of senior lawmakers." These individuals in their 30s and 40s are attacking the senior lawmakers who have sustained the Chang Dong-hyuk leadership, using terms like "self-preservationism" and "senility." Political circles interpret this as a move aimed at replacing district party chairmen and positioning ahead of the 2028 general election nominations. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 당협위원장 당원직선제를 추진하는 가운데, 친(親)장동혁계 원외 정치인들이 잇따라 ‘중진 물갈이’를 주장하고 나섰다. 30·40대인 이들은 장동혁 체제를 지탱해 온 중진 의원들을 ‘보신주의’ ‘노쇠’라는 표현을 써가며 공격에 나섰다. 정치권에선 당협위원장 교체와 2028년 총선 공천을 염두에 둔 것이라는 해석이 나온다.)

Until now, the pro-Chang faction's targets have been pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers who have demanded Chang's resignation, or non-mainstream lawmakers from the "Alternative and Future" group. But recently, the focus of criticism has shifted to senior lawmakers, including those from the former pro-Yoon faction. This movement gained momentum after Chang, targeting three-term lawmakers, said, "If you declare you won't run in the next (general) election and pave the way for young talent to join the PPP, we can achieve far better results in the next election." (그간 친장계의 공격 대상은 장 대표 사퇴를 요구해 온 친한동훈계나 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속 비주류 의원들이었다. 그런데 최근엔 옛 친윤계를 비롯한 중진 의원들로 비판 대상이 바뀌고 있다. 이런 움직임은 장 대표가 3선 의원을 겨냥해 “다음번에 (총선) 불출마 선언하고, 젊은 인재들이 국민의힘에 들어올 수 있게 길을 터주면 다음 총선에서 훨씬 더 좋은 결과를 얻을 수 있을 것”이라고 하면서 본격화됐다.)

Kim Min-soo (48), a Supreme Council member, said on a YouTube program on the 19th, "If Representative Chang Dong-hyuk completes this term, I believe the rotten parts of the PPP will be excised by the general election." Kim, who entered politics after running a building management company, failed to secure the nomination for Seongnam Bundang-eul in Gyeonggi Province in the last general election. He is leading the push for direct member votes to select district chairmen and has also advocated for Chang's re-election as party leader. (김민수(48) 최고위원은 지난 19일 한 유튜브에서 “장동혁 대표가 이 임기를 지속해 내야 총선까지 국민의힘의 썩은 부위가 도려나간다고 생각한다”고 했다. 김 최고위원은 건물 관리업체를 운영하다 정치권에 입문했고 지난 총선에서 경기 성남시 분당을 후보 공천에서 탈락했다. 당협위원장 당원직선제를 주도하고 있고 장 대표의 당대표 연임도 주장했다.)

Park Min-young (33), a media spokesperson who previously served as an administrative officer at President Yoon Suk Yeol's office, said on his YouTube channel on the 21st, "The voluntary retirement of senior groups is the foundation of reform," adding, "Those who contribute nothing to the party and are merely focused on self-preservation should be cleanly swept away." Park also argued that the position of floor leader should be reverted to "chief whip," a role appointed by the party leader for practical duties before the 2000s, rather than the current system where three-term lawmakers are elected as floor leader by a vote of lawmakers. (윤석열 대통령실 행정관을 지낸 박민영(33) 미디어대변인은 지난 21일 자신의 유튜브에서 “중진 그룹들이 용퇴를 하는 것이 쇄신의 기초”라며 “당에 기여는 안 하고 그저 보신주의(에만 몰두하는) 이런 분들은 싹 정리해야 한다”고 했다. 박 대변인은 ‘원내대표’를 ‘원내총무’로 돌리는 방안도 검토해야 한다고 주장했다. 통상 3선 의원이 맡는 원내대표는 의원들이 투표로 선출하지만 2000년대 이전 원내총무는 당대표가 임명하는 실무 역할이다.)

Spokesperson Kim Hyo-eun (43) and media spokesperson Son Su-jo (41) also appeared on YouTube channels with large numbers of hardline supporters to argue for replacing senior lawmakers. On a YouTube show on the 20th, Kim said regarding senior lawmakers, "Shouldn't we distinguish between freshness and senility based on their legislative activity so far?" On the 19th, Son said, "There should also be a three-term limit for lawmakers." Kim, a former EBS instructor, was nominated in Gyeonggi Osan in the last general election but lost, while Son lost twice in Busan Sasang and had registered as a preliminary candidate in Gyeonggi Dongducheon-Yeoncheon in the last election. (김효은(43) 대변인과 손수조(41) 미디어대변인도 강성 지지자가 많은 유튜브에 출연해 중진 교체론을 주장했다. 김 대변인은 지난 20일 한 유튜브에서 중진 의원과 관련해 “지금까지의 의정 활동을 기준으로 참신함과 노쇠함을 좀 가려야 되지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 손 미디어대변인은 지난 19일 “국회의원도 3선 연임 제한을 걸어야 한다”고 했다. EBS 강사 출신인 김 대변인은 지난 총선에서 경기 오산에 공천됐다 낙선했고, 손 대변인은 부산 사상에서 2차례 낙선한 후 지난 총선에선 경기 동두천·연천에서 예비후보에 등록했었다.)

These pro-Chang politicians in their 30s and 40s have been criticizing senior lawmakers for not attending the "Protect Voting Rights" rallies at Seoul Olympic Park, which are attended by Chang and hardline supporters. After President Lee Jae-myung's golf meeting with senior PPP lawmakers, and a gathering of three-term lawmakers critical of Chang's line, they have been broadcasting criticisms on YouTube while displaying the names and districts of senior lawmakers. A political source said, "They're clearly eyeing nominations," adding, "In the Seoul metropolitan area, following the Chang Dong-hyuk line is difficult, so they're likely to challenge in the Yeongnam region, which has a large hardline-support base." (이들 3040 친장계 정치인들은 장 대표를 비롯해 강성 지지층이 참여하고 있는 서울 올림픽 공원 ‘참정권 수호’ 집회에 중진 의원들이 불참하는 것을 비판해왔다. 이재명 대통령과 국민의힘 중진 의원들의 골프 회동, 장 대표 노선에 비판적인 3선 의원 모임 이후엔 유튜브 방송에 중진 의원들의 이름과 지역구를 띄워 놓고 비판하고 있다. 한 정치권 관계자는 “이들도 공천을 노린 것 아니겠느냐”며 “수도권에선 장동혁 노선으로는 쉽지 않은 상황이라 결국 강성 지지층이 많은 영남권에 도전할 가능성이 크다”고 했다.)

The senior lawmakers backed Chang over Kim Moon-soo, who was a party leadership candidate at the time, at the party convention in August last year. The reason was that Kim, who had rejected a unity deal with Han Duck-soo in the presidential election, was seen as "difficult to control." Even during the last local elections, when conflicts over Chang's line threatened the Seoul mayoral race, the senior group remained silent. (중진들은 작년 8월 전당대회에서 김문수 당시 대표 후보와 장 대표 사이에서 장 대표를 밀었다. 대선 당시 한덕수 후보와의 단일화를 거부한 김 후보가 “컨트롤하기 어렵다”는 이유에서였다. 지난 지방선거 당시 장 대표 노선을 둘러싼 갈등으로 서울시장 선거까지 위태로웠을 때도 중진 그룹은 침묵해 왔다.)

However, the atmosphere has shifted recently as Chang, after calling for district party chairmen to resign, has floated the direct member vote, effectively wielding early nomination power. One three-term lawmaker said, "Even if Chang kept pandering to the hardline base, Yeongnam lawmakers who stayed put thinking it didn't affect their nominations are now in a desperate situation." At a general meeting of lawmakers on the 21st, it was reported that Yeongnam senior lawmakers including Kim Tae-ho, Yoon Han-hong, and Lee Man-hee voiced opposition to changing the method of selecting district party chairmen. (하지만 최근 장 대표가 당협위원장 사퇴 후 당원직선제를 띄우며 사실상 조기 공천권 행사와 다름없는 수를 띄우자 분위기가 바뀌고 있다. 한 3선 의원은 “그간 장 대표가 아무리 강성층에 기대는 행보를 해오더라도 자신들의 공천과는 무관하다고 생각해 움직이지 않던 영남권 의원들도 이제는 발등에 불 떨어진 상황이 된 것”이라고 했다. 지난 21일 의원총회에서는 김태호, 윤한홍, 이만희 의원 등 영남권 중진 의원들을 중심으로 당협위원장 선출 방식 개정에 반대하는 취지의 발언이 잇따른 것으로 전해졌다.)

Meanwhile, the PPP is expected to reach a conclusion on the method of selecting district party chairmen at a Supreme Council meeting on the 24th. At a previous Supreme Council meeting, only two of the eight attendees opposed Chang's reform plan. At last week's general meeting of lawmakers, however, lawmakers opposed the plan. A party official said, "If Chang and the factions holding party power push this through, the conflict with senior lawmakers will explode even more." (이런 가운데 국민의힘은 24일 최고위원 회의에서 당협위원장 선출 방안에 대해 결론을 내릴 전망이다. 앞서 열린 최고위에서는 최고위 참석자 8명 중 2명만 장 대표의 개편안에 반대했다. 지난주 열린 의원총회에서 의원들은 개편안에 반대한 상황이다. 당 관계자는 “장 대표와 당권파가 이를 밀어붙이면 중진들과의 갈등은 더욱 폭발할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: 90-Degree Bows, Attire Innovation, All Lawmakers on Duty… Kim Min-seok's Ideas Leave Lawmakers Perplexed (90도 인사, 복장 혁신, 의원 모두 당직… 김민석 아이디어에 의원들 당황)
item.description:
90-Degree Bows, Attire Innovation, All Lawmakers on Duty… Kim Min-seok's Ideas Leave Lawmakers Perplexed (90도 인사, 복장 혁신, 의원 모두 당직… 김민석 아이디어에 의원들 당황)

Kim Min-seok, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, has become a hot topic for performing a 90-degree bow together with lawmakers at his first general meeting of lawmakers after taking office. Representative Kim said, "Let's bow as a gesture of 'we will work hard' toward the public and party members," but reactions of "it's embarrassing" followed not only from the opposition but also from pro-ruling party communities. As controversy grew, Representative Kim said, "It seems it came across as excessive," adding, "We'll refine it soon." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 취임 후 첫 의원총회에서 의원들과 함께 90도 인사를 한 것이 화제다. 김 대표는 “국민과 당원들을 향해 ‘열심히 하겠습니다’ 하는 뜻에서 절을 하자”고 했지만 이후 야권뿐 아니라 친여 커뮤니티에서도 “낯 뜨겁다”는 반응이 이어졌다. 논란이 되자 김 대표는 “과해보였나보다”며 “곧 다듬겠다”고 했다.)

Since taking office on the 17th, Representative Kim has been rolling out his "Kim Min-seok-style" initiatives. The 90-degree bow was one of them. One Democratic Party lawmaker said, "I didn't notice during the bow itself, but when I saw the photos later, I felt a wave of cringe." The People Power Party, in a statement on the 23rd, pointed out, "The Democratic Party's '90-degree bow to the big brother'—instead of wasting time on that, they should start with a '90-degree bow of reflection' toward the public. The reason the public finds this performance uncomfortable is that genuine humility toward the people has disappeared, leaving only an awkward scene of them bowing to each other." (김 대표는 지난 17일 취임 이후 ‘김민석표’ 구상을 쏟아내고 있다. 90도 인사도 그 중 하나로 나온 것이다. 한 민주당 의원은 “인사를 할 때는 몰랐는데 나중에 사진을 보니 ‘현타’가 오더라”고 했다. 국민의힘은 23일 논평에서 “민주당의 ‘90도 형님 인사’, 그럴 시간에 국민을 향한 ’90도 반성 인사’부터 하라”며 “국민이 이 퍼포먼스를 불편해하는 이유는 국민을 향한 겸손은 사라진 채, 자기들끼리 허리를 숙이는 낯뜨거운 장면만 남았다는 사실”이라고 지적했다.)

As debate over the 90-degree bow continued even within the ruling camp, Representative Kim wrote on X on the 22nd, "The bow, proposed by Public Relations Committee Chairman Kim Nam-joon, was a courteous gesture at a 45-degree angle," adding, "We did it once with all lawmakers and once with the Supreme Council members. With everyone doing it and bowing deeply, it seems it looked excessive." He continued, "The impression varies depending on the camera angle, and I trust that Chairman Kim will soon refine a group greeting method that is both meaningful and visually appealing." (이에 김 대표는 여권 내에서도 90도 인사를 두고 설왕설래가 이어지자 22일 X에 “김남준 홍보위원장 제안에 따른 절은 45도 각도의 정중례였다”며 “의원 전체 한 번, 최고위원 한 번 해보았는데 여럿이 하고 깊이 숙이니 과해 보였나 보다”고 했다. 그러면서 “사진 각도에 따라서도 느낌이 다르고, 김 위원장께서 의미도 좋고 보기도 좋은 단체 인사법을 곧 다듬어주시리라 믿는다”고 했다.)

Representative Kim also announced he would innovate the lawmakers' attire. He said he would overhaul the party's brand concept and even its meeting methods, and is also pushing to establish a new party headquarters in Gwanghwamun. He proposed creating the party's own broadcast channel, "Minju TV," and has already scheduled his first appearance for early September. He also unveiled a plan to assign official party duties to all Democratic Party lawmakers. (김 대표는 의원들의 복장도 혁신하겠다고 했다. 당의 브랜드 콘셉트와 회의 방식까지 손보겠다고 했고, 광화문에 새 당사를 마련하는 방안도 추진하고 있다. 당 자체 방송인 ‘민주TV’를 만드는 방안도 제시했는데, 일단 김 대표가 9월 초 첫 출연을 하기로 했다. 민주당 의원 전원이 당직을 맡도록 하는 구상도 내놨다.)

Within the party, there are reactions that while the intention to show a fresh image early in his tenure is understood, "there's so much being promised that it's confusing." One lawmaker said, "I trust that when Representative Kim talks about attire innovation, he doesn't mean having everyone wear matching outfits. And the idea of assigning party duties to all lawmakers is hard to grasp as well. It seems overly staged, and the approach itself doesn't really resonate." (당내에서는 김 대표가 취임 초반 변화상을 보여주려는 취지는 이해하지만 “하겠다는 것이 너무 많아 헷갈린다”는 반응도 나온다. 한 의원은 “김 대표가 말하는 복장 혁신이 설마 옷을 단체로 맞춰 입고 다니겠다는 소린 아니리라 믿는다”며 “또 의원 전원에게 당직을 맡기겠다는 것도 이해가 좀처럼 어렵다. 과도하게 연출된 것 같고 방식 자체가 크게 와닿지는 않는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Bypassing Oh Se-hoon? Ruling Party and Government "Give Authority for Redevelopment of 500 or Fewer Households to District Office Heads" (오세훈 패싱? 당정 “500세대 이하 재개발 권한 구청장에게”)
item.description:
Bypassing Oh Se-hoon? Ruling Party and Government "Give Authority for Redevelopment of 500 or Fewer Households to District Office Heads" (오세훈 패싱? 당정 “500세대 이하 재개발 권한 구청장에게”)

The government and the ruling party decided on the 23rd at a high-level government-ruling party consultative meeting to push forward a plan to transfer the authority to approve permits for redevelopment and reconstruction projects involving 500 or fewer households from metropolitan government heads, such as the Seoul mayor, to basic local government heads, such as district office heads. This is an issue that has been demanded by Democratic Party district office heads, and in Seoul's case, 17 of the 25 districts have Democratic Party district office heads. The Seoul Metropolitan Government is opposed, citing concerns over administrative inefficiency and unplanned development. <<> Park Seong-jun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a briefing that day, "We have decided to improve the system to allow the authority for redevelopment and reconstruction of 500 or fewer households to be granted to basic local government heads, synthesizing the demands of Seoul's district office heads," adding, "We have formed a consensus on shortening the approval period through the transfer of authority and will pursue related legislation in the National Assembly." He continued, "Through this, we will be able to receive the authority and push forward private redevelopment and reconstruction projects more swiftly." The current Article 8 of the Urban Development Act stipulates that the Seoul Metropolitan Government has jurisdiction over the designation of maintenance zones. Changes to maintenance zones that can be handled by autonomous districts, such as area, building coverage ratio, and floor area ratio, are also currently restricted to within 10%, and the plan is to significantly ease this. <<> Transferring the authority to approve permits for redevelopment and reconstruction projects of a certain scale or smaller to district office heads was a pledge made by Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-o, who faced off against Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon during the local elections in June. A Democratic Party official said, "This is also a measure that Democratic Party-affiliated district office heads have long requested of the party." The Democratic Party expects that if redevelopment authority is transferred to autonomous districts, administrative procedures can be significantly reduced and project timelines shortened. <<> Regarding granting the authority to approve permits for projects of 500 or fewer households to district offices, the Seoul Metropolitan Government maintains the position that "for redevelopment and reconstruction in Seoul, which forms a single living zone, integrated review at the city level is essential, and without a control tower, unplanned development will occur." A Seoul Metropolitan Government official said, "Even if authority is transferred to district office heads, matters such as zoning upgrades would ultimately still be subject to review by the city's Urban Planning Committee, so the review process would only become bifurcated, increasing administrative inefficiency," adding, "Due to the lack of experience in individual autonomous districts, administrative confusion and project delays are actually a concern." (정부·여당은 23일 고위당정협의회에서 500세대 이하 재개발·재건축 사업 인허가권을 서울시장 등 광역단체장에서 구청장 등 기초단체장에게 넘기는 방안을 추진하기로 했다. 민주당 구청장들이 요구해온 사안으로, 서울의 경우 25구 가운데 17곳이 민주당 구청장이다. 서울시는 행정 비효율과 난개발을 우려하며 반대하는 입장이다.)

item.title: Approval Ratings Slip... Ruling Party Demands Revisions to Key Property Tax Hikes (지지율 떨어지자… 與, 부동산 증세 핵심 내용들 수정 요구)
item.description:
Approval Ratings Slip... Ruling Party Demands Revisions to Key Property Tax Hikes (지지율 떨어지자… 與, 부동산 증세 핵심 내용들 수정 요구)

The Democratic Party of Korea, the government, and the Blue House held a high-level ruling party-government consultative meeting on the 23rd at the Prime Minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, to discuss the property tax reform plan announced by the government on the 3rd. As approval ratings for the administration fell after the plan was unveiled, the ruling party leadership openly stated that day that policy revisions were unavoidable. The meeting, which lasted two and a half hours, also addressed housing supply measures and priority bills for the regular session of the National Assembly in September, but the property tax issue was reportedly the most extensively discussed topic. <<> ◇Two and a half hours of intensive discussion on property taxes <<> On the 3rd, the government announced a tax reform plan raising the threshold for comprehensive real estate holding tax on single-homeowners from a publicly announced value of 1.2 billion won (approximately 1.74 billion won in market price) to 1.4 billion won (approximately 2.03 billion won), in line with rising apartment prices. However, the basic deduction reducing the taxable base—the standard for calculating taxes—was set at 1.4 billion won for actual residents and 900 million won for non-residents. Someone owning a home worth 1.4 billion won would pay no comprehensive real estate tax if they are an actual resident, but a non-resident would owe tax on 500 million won of that value. Since a significant number of 20- and 30-pyeong apartments in Seoul's "Maple-Yongsan-Seongdong" areas are worth well over 2 billion won in market price, non-residents could see their taxes rise sharply. <<> The government also proposed splitting the long-term holding special deduction, which reduces capital gains tax for long-term homeowners selling their property, into a long-term "residency" deduction and a long-term "holding" deduction, with the long-term holding deduction to be abolished starting in 2029. This means non-residents would no longer receive capital gains tax reductions. <<> At the meeting, ruling party participants reportedly agreed on the need for the government's property tax reform but expressed concerns that sharply increasing both holding and transaction taxes, particularly for non-resident single-homeowners, could trigger adverse effects. Park Sung-joon, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, said at a briefing on the meeting's outcome: "Regarding the comprehensive real estate tax, the Democratic Party strongly requested that no distinction be made between residents and non-residents for single-homeowners." <<> The Democratic Party was understood to have called for easing the reduction of the long-term holding special deduction, arguing that non-resident single-homeowners, facing reduced benefits, might evict tenants and move in themselves, exacerbating the rental market crisis. The party also demanded expanding the "exceptions" beyond the government's proposal to grant non-residents the same deduction benefits as actual residents in cases such as education or childcare needs. <<> Ahead of the high-level meeting, during a session organized by the Democratic Party leadership to gather opinions on the tax reform plan, many lawmakers, particularly from the Seoul metropolitan area, reportedly voiced concerns about taxing non-resident single-homeowners. One senior lawmaker from a Seoul district said, "It's not uncommon for homes to exceed 2 billion won in market price within a year, so taxes go up even if you do nothing. If we add deliberate tax hikes on top of that, we'll struggle to handle the backlash from residents." <<> ◇First ruling party-government meeting since Kim Min-seok took the helm as leader; government likely to accept demands <<> How far the government will accommodate the Democratic Party's demands was not finalized at the meeting. A senior government official said, "Government participants listened to the party's arguments in detail and responded that they would 'consider them thoroughly.'" Specific figures, such as tax thresholds, were not discussed at the meeting. The Blue House stated that it had "received the party's position and requests regarding the tax treatment of non-resident single-homeowners." <<> However, within the ruling camp, there is an expectation that a significant portion of the Democratic Party's demands will be reflected in the property tax reform plan. A ruling camp source said, "Since tax reform requires amending tax laws, the government's role is to propose, and the actual decision rests with the National Assembly and the ruling party. As this is the first high-level ruling party-government meeting since Kim Min-seok took over as party leader, it seems highly likely the Blue House will adopt a stance of 'accepting reasonable criticisms and making adjustments.'" <<> When the government announced the tax reform plan on the 3rd, the Democratic Party had initially welcomed it. Han Byung-do, then acting party leader and floor leader, said at a party meeting on the 4th, "The tax reform plan protects actual resident single-homeowners while reasonably adjusting benefits excessively concentrated in ultra-high-priced and non-resident homes," calling it "tax normalization." <<> But as public opinion strengthened that the government was trying to curb real estate through taxes, and President Lee Jae-myung's approval ratings fell, the Democratic Party quickly reversed course. The property tax reform became a major issue at the party's national convention this month, and candidates for party leader, including Kim Min-seok, stated their opposition to reducing the comprehensive real estate tax deduction for non-resident single-homeowners and to the blanket abolition of the long-term holding special deduction. (더불어민주당과 정부, 청와대는 23일 서울 종로구 삼청동 국무총리공관에서 고위당정협의회를 열고 정부가 지난 3일 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안을 논의했다. 개편안 발표 이후 국정 지지율이 하락하자 여당 지도부는 이날 정책 수정이 불가피하다는 입장을 공개적으로 밝혔다. 2시간 30분간 진행된 이날 회의는 부동산 공급 대책, 9월 정기국회 중점 처리 법안 등도 논의됐지만 부동산 세금 문제가 가장 오래 다뤄졌다고 한다.)

item.title: South Korean PM Orders Full Investigation into Jeju Disappearance Case (韓총리 “제주 실종사건 수사 전과정 조사하라”)
item.description:
South Korean PM Orders Full Investigation into Jeju Disappearance Case (韓총리 “제주 실종사건 수사 전과정 조사하라”)

Prime Minister Han Duck-soo expressed strong regret on the 23rd over the police's controversial closure of the "Jeju Jang Mi-ran disappearance case," instructing authorities to "conduct a thorough investigation into the entire investigation process." As concerns were raised again over the vacuum left by the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers—a move led by the Democratic Party—the party stated, "We will put together supplementary measures to ensure the public has no concerns." (한성숙 국무총리는 23일 경찰의 ‘제주 장미란씨 실종 사건’ 허위 종결 논란에 대해 강한 유감을 표하며 “수사 과정 전반에 대해 철저히 진상을 조사하라”고 지시했다. 더불어민주당은 자신들이 주도해 없앤 검사의 보완수사권의 공백에 대한 우려가 재차 제기되자 “국민들의 우려가 없도록 보완책을 잘 마련하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The Prime Minister's Office said in a press release that morning, "The Prime Minister expressed strong regret over the series of controversies surrounding the police's inadequate handling of missing person investigations in Jeju." Han instructed the National Police Agency to "conduct a thorough investigation into the entire investigation process of this case and closely verify whether police falsely closed the case during the receipt and handling of the missing person report," adding, "Prepare fundamental measures to prevent recurrence and report back promptly." (총리실은 이날 오전 보도자료에서 “한 총리가 제주에서 잇따라 발생한 경찰의 실종 수사 부실 논란에 대해 강한 유감을 표명했다”고 밝혔다. 한 총리는 경찰청에 “이번 사건 수사 과정 전반에 대해 철저히 진상을 조사하고, 경찰이 실종 신고 접수·처리 과정에서 허위로 사건을 종결하는 등의 행위가 없는지 면밀히 확인하라”며 “근본적인 재발방지 대책을 조속히 마련해 보고하라”고 지시했다.)

Park Sung-joon, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, told reporters regarding the Jeju disappearance case, "Isn't the Criminal Procedure Act going to be revised going forward?" adding, "I understand that various supplementary measures were put in place, and if problems arise later, we will address them one by one." (민주당 박성준 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 이번 제주 실종 사건과 관련해 “앞으로 형사소송법이 개정되지 않느냐”며 “여러 보완책이 마련됐던 것으로 알고 추후 문제점이 있다고 하면 보완책들을 하나하나 마련하겠다”고 말했다.)

Previously, the Democratic Party pushed through the full abolition of supplementary investigation powers despite public opposition following the Jang Yun-gi case. Instead, they are also promoting a plan that would allow the prosecution service to request supplementary investigations from the Serious Crimes Investigation Office if primary investigative agencies fail to properly investigate crimes against socially vulnerable groups, such as child abuse, before referring them. However, concerns about gaps and delays in investigations resulting from the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers remain unresolved. Within the Democratic Party, some have expressed worries about police investigative capabilities, with remarks such as "The police's self-closure of the Jeju disappearance case shows that supplementary measures are needed for the overall structure in which investigative agencies close cases on their own." (앞서 민주당은 장윤기 사건으로 인한 보완수사권 폐지 반대 여론에도 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 강행한 바 있다. 대신 1차 수사기관이 아동학대 등 사회적 약자를 상대로 한 범죄를 제대로 수사하지 않고 송치할 경우 공소청이 중대범죄수사청(중수청)에 보완수사를 요구할 수 있도록 하는 방안도 추진하고 있다. 다만 검사의 보완수사 폐지로 인한 수사 공백과 지연 등에 대한 우려는 해소되지 않고 있다. 민주당 일각에선 경찰이 제주 실종 사건을 자체 종결한 것을 두고 “수사기관이 스스로 사건을 종결하는 구조 전반에 대한 보완책이 필요하다”며 경찰 수사 역량에 대한 걱정이 나오고 있다.)

The People Power Party has taken the stance of "immediately retract the abolition of supplementary investigation powers." Party spokesperson Cho Yong-sul said in a statement that day, "Already, the harmful practice of police conducting 'self-investigations' and drawing conclusions on their own internal errors is occurring," adding, "We must first re-establish the checks and accountability mechanisms designed to protect the public." Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo criticized the police, saying, "Form a dedicated investigation team for missing persons nationwide and conduct a full review." <<>> (국민의힘은 “보완수사권 폐지를 즉각 철회하라”는 입장이다. 국민의힘 조용술 대변인은 이날 논평에서 “벌써부터 경찰 내부의 잘못을 경찰이 ‘셀프 수사’하고 결론내리는 폐단이 벌어지고 있다”며 “국민을 보호하기 위한 견제와 책임의 장치부터 다시 세워야 한다”고 했다. 주진우 의원은 “전국 실종자들에 대한 전담 수사팀을 꾸리고 전수 조사를 진행하라”며 경찰을 비판했다.)
